messages.body: Morning. Q1 lives here now. Please rescue anything useful from the old chat before Teams eats it.
The Hartwell Foundation wants the narrative and financial report in the same submission.
The donor submission is due in two weeks. That's the date on their confirmation email.
@Juliana Pardo can you take the narrative draft? the one in the folder is basically headings atm
sí, narrative is mine. got the field notes open already
Leave the financial workbook with me. There's a clean export now, not the one with the duplicated fuel line.
Q1 report kickoff is Thursday at 10. Calendar hold is out.
Hola from the Lima office! Regional grants hat on: is this the workbook with the FX tab?
Yep, tab 4. It was hidden in the old one.
I'd put the results table in the narrative body, not in an annex. Otherwise the activity paragraphs all point off-page.
fine by me, keep it in the body
First narrative draft goes in the shared folder by end of the week. It'll be rough but readable.
if anyone needs me I'm downstairs eating before the rain starts
I'll reconcile the field counts against the registers. Two sites used different names for the same activity.
Can we make next Monday the cutoff for the reconciled field counts? Still waiting on one register scan.
dale, Monday for counts works
Which grant code goes in the blank box on the donor cover sheet? There are two in the old email footer.
Sorry for the late ping. Kid's got a fever and I've only just opened the laptop.
Calling off the kickoff this morning. No need to join if the hold is still showing.
Let's show the category totals in COP only. The foundation can still see the conversion on its own tab.
ok, COP only in the category totals then
Draft's in the folder. Ignore the yellow bits, they're mostly me arguing with myself.
oh good I thought the yellow meant you were yelling at me
Small win: Hartwell confirmed the extension. Donor submission moves to April 10.
great, I'll handle the submission to Hartwell myself
Do photos need to go in the submission or does Hartwell just want the writeup?
Just the writeup. Photos aren't on the checklist.
Counts are reconciled. Latest sheet is called Counts Q1, no super final v7 nonsense this time.
👏 a historic day for file names
Suggestion: we could add a one-page infographic at the front. Something for people who won't read the narrative.
Power cut on my block. If I vanish it's the router, not a protest about the template.
same here, running on phone data
Could we pull the donor submission back to next Monday? Just thinking about getting it out of our inboxes.
No, let's not move it earlier. Finance needs the time.
@Mateo Rincón can you translate the participant quotes into English for the internal notes?
Were the double entries from the east site taken out of the count?
Yes, those are out. The rows are greyed in the register, not deleted.
Let's call people 'participants' throughout the narrative. Right now it's three terms for the same people.
vale, participants it is
Power back. Also found my coffee from Tues in the microwave. A mixed evening.
Finance workbook locks on 10/04 at noon. The reconciliation tab's finally behaving.
Is the travel line in pesos or dollars? the cell format just has a $
Pesos. Same for the whole source tab.
Opened the narrative on a small screen. That table has a very long right-hand side :/
In that case let's move the results table out of the body and into Annex A. We can leave just the headline count in the text.
yes, Annex A. The version in the body is too wide even on my laptop.
Has anyone got the stamped receipt from last quarter's upload? Not the auto-email, the one with the stamp.
Narrative comments close tomorrow end of day. Track changes is on now fyi.
Internal sign-off is booked for the 14th, 11 am. Not the donor upload.
sorry, I meant the 15th not the 14th. Same time for sign-off.
lunch downstairs? rain looks like it's holding off
you've jinxed it
Are the annex headings locked by the donor or can we change them?
Annex headings are ours. Only the main template headings are fixed.
Narrative and annex both say 382 now. Checked against the register total, not the dashboard.
gracias. the dashboard number was haunting me
Forwarded you the donor email. Submission has moved again, to April 16. That's confirmed, not a request from us.
Does that affect the workbook lock?
No, internal dates stay put. Just the submission moved.
Narrative comments closed. The only leftover bubble is me replying 'thanks' to a resolved one 🙃
The zero on the equipment line is intentional btw. It's not a missing formula.
ahh ok. It was the only zero with two decimals so I stared at it for a while
Anybody know who has edit access to the old Q1 archive? The permissions panel won't load for me.
whoever took my yogurt, I respect the choice but pls not the spoon too
not me, I'm still on the emergency crackers
Workbook's locked. The hidden workings are still there, just protected.
Is the locked one still called Q1 Financial or did that change?
Still Q1 Financial. Blue lock icon beside it on my screen.
The PDF preview finally loaded over here. Annex A looks much better.
thank goodness. It cut off an entire colum in my first export
Morning. The scanner is making the sound it makes when it's done with us.
the angry beep or the little grinding noise
both! very talented machine
Narrative PDF and workbook are both visible in the submission folder now. Thanks all.
The PDF preview in Teams had weird spacing but the actual download is fine.
Is the notes doc internal only? I saw it beside the PDFs earlier.
Yes, internal only. It's not in the submission folder.
COP totals match the narrative amounts now. The earlier difference was just rounding in the text.
My kid is back at school btw. Thanks for being patient with the late messages.
Sign-off done. No changes to either file.
niceeee
Both signed-off files open here too. Logging off before I find another reason to zoom to 200%.
Submitted to Hartwell. Both attachments show on the confirmation screen.
🙌 thank you Colombia team
That's the sound of me closing 14 tabs.
only 14? showoff
Hartwell acknowledged both files this morning. Nothing else requested in their note.
beautiful. coffee that is not reheated now
